name: R 290
tagline: A 290 litre heat pump hot water system for bigger households.
summary: The Ecogenica R 290 is a workhorse. At 290 litres, there is enough hot water to satisfy the most discerning users.
It delivers piping hot water at an economical price, pushing back against rising energy bills and putting you back in control.
